label: Receive Email
description: Fires when an email lands in a mailbox's inbox, watched over IMAP (no public address or provider app needed), optionally filtered by sender and subject.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs the connection's IMAP server filled.

inputs.name: fromContains
inputs.label: From contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the sender contains this
inputs.description: Only fire when the From header contains this. Empty = any sender.

inputs.name: subjectContains
inputs.label: Subject contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the subject contains this
inputs.description: Only fire when the subject contains this. Empty = any subject.

outputs.name: messageId
outputs.description: Message-ID header; give it to SendEmail's replyToMessageId to reply in thread.
